# Cedar consensus
Cedar finality requires two-thirds of validator stake; Cedar stops finalizing when more than one-third is offline.
## Cedar permissions
Cedar validators cannot pause user withdrawals. Cedar does not receive Transit Bridge fees.
## Transit Bridge operations
Transit Bridge runs on Cedar. Transit Bridge charges a 2% withdrawal fee and its operator may pause bridge withdrawals; these are Transit Bridge powers, not Cedar consensus powers.
## Luma Protocol
Luma Protocol runs on Cedar and earns lending fees. Luma Protocol fees do not automatically accrue to LUMA holders.
## LUMA rights
LUMA is the governance token of Luma Protocol. LUMA holders may vote only after delegation; LUMA holders have no documented entitlement to Luma Protocol fees.
## Luma Protocol release 1
Luma Protocol release 1 requires a seven-day withdrawal delay.
## Luma Protocol release 2
Luma Protocol release 2 requires a one-day withdrawal delay; this replaces the release 1 delay only for release 2 deployments.
## Reference: Cedar recovery
Cedar recovery requires validators to return online; Transit Bridge operators cannot restore Cedar finality.
